unresolvedRisks: The broker accepts references only on a unix socket; a cluster deployment needs a node-local socket arrangement or an mTLS transport that does not exist yet.

Compose cannot separate ingress from egress for the published api and sensor-gateway (edge network); only the reference Kubernetes policy encodes the API's egress restriction, and it was never applied.
pg's pgpass support (used for DATABASE_URL without a password) is deprecated for pg@9; move to a password callback reading the secret file.
HttpsCmmsAdapter.fromEnv still reads UB_CMMS_TOKEN from process.env when called with defaults (M11); the worker never does, but any other caller could.
A poison outbox event holds the queue (by design, never dropped); recovery is the documented runbook plus the outbox-age alert, which pages nobody yet.
The release-gate authorizer registry is a repository file: a person with write access could register a key; changes to config/release/authorizers.json must be reviewed like code.
The claim check is a lexicon over visible text; it fails closed on hidden or encoded text but cannot understand every phrasing of a real-world claim.

The recorded rollback went from the candidate to fc611a9 and back: the worker image differs in code (the lock-session serialization fix), while the api and sensor-gateway images differ only by build (their runtime code is unchanged between the two refs). specAmbiguitiesResolved: T-057 at the local layer is a fresh-clone compose bring-up; its canonical status stays NOT_RUN until a hosted, authorized deployment is verified from a clean client.
Simulated or recorded evidence offered to the real-input gate is FAIL (an attempt to satisfy it with non-real evidence), absence is NOT_RUN.
Collapsed <details> is not rendered-visible: drafts may not contain raw HTML or details at all (fail closed).
Authorizations are Ed25519-signed by a registered key, valid at most 24 h (payments 4 h), single use; the gate never performs the action.
Runner locks are session advisory locks on one dedicated session per replica, outside the ADR 0006 order (taken first, never waited on).
LICENSE: the spec names no license; the MIT LICENSE committed in M00 is kept and recorded here (EVENT-NOTES requires the license to be re-checked before publication).
securityReview: Bring-up: API crashed after listening when its operations listener was enabled (double metric registration) -> 508a1c4 red, 1ac7593 fix.
R1 claim check accepted generic words (without, never, is not, UNKNOWN) as qualifiers -> explicit evidence-status words only (58c65aa red, bb56075 fix).
R2 a qualifier in an HTML comment excused a visible claim -> visible text only (same commits).
R3 journey artifacts were not bound to their journey directory -> ARTIFACT_FROM_OTHER_JOURNEY.
R4 authorization validity was unbounded -> per-gate maximum (24 h, payments 4 h).
R5 single use was not enforced by the tooling -> checkAndRecord consumes on AUTHORIZED and logs decisions.
R6 journey gate took a database URL on argv -> JOURNEY_DATABASE_URL only.
R7 an interrupted smoke run left containers, volumes and throwaway keys -> SIGINT/SIGTERM cleanup (7f318a0 red, d455e4b fix).
R8 payment cap came from the manifest -> verified against the signed PAYMENT scope (same commits).

R9 (coordinator) comments stripped per line; multi-line or unclosed comments, zero-width characters, entities, details, raw HTML and link reference definitions could hide qualifiers -> whole-document rendered-visible view with fail-closed findings and exact line numbers (c726c76 red, 8cc965b fix).

Implementation findings fixed in place before review: one lock connection per runner could exhaust the pool (deadlock) -> one lock session per replica; a dead lock session crashed the process -> client error listener and lock-loss abort; overlapping queries on the lock session (deprecated in pg) -> serialized (3c72390); the restore digest hashed only the first column -> whole-row digest.

Reviewed without finding: Dockerfile layers (no secret, broker-only broker target, non-root), compose exposure (loopback only, ops listeners unpublished, worker without egress), FileSecretStore traversal and symlink handling, constant-time operations token comparison, release-gate signature canonicalization, smoke report redaction (no password, token or key in the recorded evidence; secret scan clean).
